summary: Records a pit-machine state change. Reads the current state at this+0x184 (388) and returns unchanged when the new state a2 equals it. On a genuine transition, optionally stamps the session time from dbl_8AFEA0 into this+0x18C (396) for transitions to 1 or to 2 from a state other than 1, advances a ring-buffer write cursor (dword_8AAE64) once a bounded counter (dword_83EE60, cap 1023) permits, encodes a progress-bar event of type 6 using the event id at this+4, writes a2 into the new ring-buffer entry, and dispatches the AI state machine on that entry.

operations.description: Read result = *(this + 0x184), the current pit-machine state.
Guard: when a2 == result (no state change) return result immediately.
Guard: stamp the session timestamp into this+0x18C when a2 == 1, or when result != 1 and a2 == 2.
Write *(this + 0x18C) = dbl_8AFEA0 (record session time on the transition).
Read v3 = dword_8AAE64, the ring-buffer write pointer.
Guard: only advance the ring buffer while dword_83EE60 < 1023.
Increment dword_83EE60 and advance the write pointer: dword_8AAE64 += 432 (entry stride).
Call ProgressBarEventEncode(6, 1, 1, *(this + 4), LODWORD(dbl_8AFEA0), 0) to encode a progress-bar event using the event id at this+4.
Write the new state into the ring-buffer entry: *(v3 + 8) = a2.
Call AIStateMachineWithModeDispatch(v3) to process the newly recorded ring-buffer entry.
Return result (the prior state) when no transition occurred.

unresolved: Exact meaning of state values 1 and 2 for the pit machine is not established by this packet.
The 432-byte ring-buffer entry layout beyond offset +8 is unknown.
Semantics of dbl_8AFEA0 (existing analysis proposes session time) are not proven by this packet.
